title: HybridQuant: Task-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient Large Language Model Deployment on Edge Devices
content: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on resource-constrained edge devices remains a significant challenge due to their massive parameter counts and memory requirements. We present HybridQuant, a novel task-aware mixedprecision quantization framework. It enables efficient LLM deployment through adaptive compression strategies. Our approach integrates three key innovations: (1) a layer-wise sensitivity analysis algorithm for dynamic bit-width allocation combining W4A16 and INT8/FP8 quantization, (2) joint optimization of 2:4 structured sparsity with quantization to leverage hardware acceleration, and (3) an adaptive KV cache compression technique specifically designed for long-context scenarios. Through extensive experiments on Llama-2 models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters across multiple benchmarks including MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval, we demonstrate that HybridQuant achieves 10-20× model compression while retaining more than 95% of the original model accuracy. On edge devices including Jetson AGX Orin and mobile GPUs, our method delivers 1.62.1× inference speedup with 4.2× memory reduction compared to FP16 baselines. The framework provides a practical and efficient solution for deploying state-of-the-art LLMs in resourceconstrained environments.
